tools.name: kombify_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search kombify product knowledge and documentation. Use for questions about kombify products, features, setup, and how-tos. Returns short text snippets with source ids.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. the user's question in their own words.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 3.

tools.name: kombify_docs_lookup
tools.description: Fetch one kombify knowledge document by its source id. Use after kombify_knowledge_search returned a source id that needs more detail.

source_id.description: Source or document id from a previous kombify_knowledge_search result.

call_response_ok.result_text: kombify TechStack bundles reproducible homelab stacks with managed deployment templates and connects them to the kombify Cloud.

call_response_denied.message: The voice tool bridge is disabled on this deployment.

user_guidance.title: Voice tools unavailable
user_guidance.body: Live knowledge tools are switched off for voice sessions in this environment. The voice session continues without tools.

error.message: The voice tool bridge is disabled on this deployment.
